Horace Grant

Horace Junior Grant

(The General, The Enforcer)

Position: Power Forward and Center ▪ Shoots: Right

6-10, 215lb (208cm, 97kg)

Born: July 4, 1965 in Augusta, Georgia us

Relatives: Brother Harvey Grant; Nephews Jerami Grant, Jerian Grant, Jerai Grant

College: Clemson

High School: Hancock Central in Sparta, Georgia

Draft: Chicago Bulls, 1st round (10th pick, 10th overall), 1987 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: November 7, 1987

Career Length: 17 years

  • 1x All Star
  • 4x NBA Champ
  • 4x All-Defensive

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Horace Grant?

Horace Grant is 60 years old.

Where was Horace Grant born?

Horace Grant was born in Augusta, Georgia.

When was Horace Grant born?

Horace Grant was born on July 4, 1965.

How tall is Horace Grant?

Horace Grant is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Horace Grant weigh when playing?

Horace Grant weighed 215 lbs (97 kg) when playing.

Is Horace Grant in the Hall of Fame?

Horace Grant is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Horace Grant drafted?

Horace Grant was drafted by Chicago Bulls, 1st round (10th pick, 10th overall), 1987 NBA Draft.

What position did Horace Grant play?

Power Forward and Center.

When did Horace Grant retire?

Horace Grant last played in 2004.

What is Horace Grant's net worth?

Horace Grant made at least $67,957,213 playing professional basketball.

How much did Horace Grant make?

Horace Grant made $14,857,000 in 1997.

What did Horace Grant average?

Horace Grant averaged 11.2 points, 8.1 rebounds, and 2.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Horace Grant have?

Horace Grant won 4 championships.

What schools did Horace Grant attend?

Horace Grant attended Hancock Central in Sparta, Georgia and Clemson.

What are Horace Grant's nicknames?

The General, The Enforcer are nicknames for Horace Grant.
